title: Culturalink: AI-Driven World Cultural Linking and Interactions Engine
summary: Culturalink organizes heritage information and generates cultural narratives, and it uses the DeepSeek language model to link heritages; no source measures a learning or preservation result.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: The Culturalink website names Yi Zeng of the Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences, as principal investigator. The site was public by 25 January 2025. In the 2025 report of the International Telecommunication Union (ITU), current as of June 2025, the project team describes a research platform that organizes heritage information and generates cultural narratives. The final ITU report names DeepSeek as the language model behind the cross-heritage links. The team describes benefits for learning, representation and preservation and measures none of them. The site was still online in October 2026, and it reports no usage or learning results.
purpose: Help people explore relationships across cultural heritage and traditions.
model_version: DeepSeek (large language model used for cross-heritage reasoning)

The developers' own site, under the platform's earlier name and at an address that now redirects to culturalink.ai, says that the engine's AI algorithms and large language models discover and summarize the links between heritage sites.
